current_logic.universe_selection: CS_RANK screening with anchor/macro loading; hard-stop if universe < 3 symbols.
current_logic.regime_classification: Canonical 4-state HMM with 4-feature diet (Trend, Vol, Downside Vol, CS Dispersion) and TVTP (Time-Varying Transition Probabilities) for enhanced stickiness. Uses Student-t or Gaussian causal filtering.
current_logic.regime_boosting: Step 3.5: Causal Forward Window (24 bars) with Exponential Decay Boost (Initial 0.90, Decay 0.97) for risk-off states when supervised tail signals fire.
current_logic.hazard_overlay: Separate tail/crisis hazard layer estimates pre_crisis_hazard, realized_crisis_hazard, and 4h/8h/24h tail hazards from 1h features and regime posterior.
current_logic.policy_mapping: Policy mapper converts regime posterior and hazard outputs into gross, Kelly, long, short, flat, and rebalance controls.
current_logic.alpha_generation: LightGBM v6 alpha is regime-conditional, with chop-fragility filtering.
current_logic.risk_management: Realized-crisis hazard and policy flat-gate replace primary dependence on hmm_prob_crisis as the execution control signal.
current_logic.runtime_bootstrap: JAX is pinned to CPU-only initialization in this environment to avoid CUDA plugin probing during imports.
current_logic.parallel_processing: Optimized for 8-core/16GB RAM: 4 workers, 4 chunk size cap to ensure ~4GB RAM per worker.
